items.title: Qualcomm falls on weak fourth quarter earnings guidance
items.summary: SAN DIEGO - Qualcomm Inc (NASDAQ:QCOM) reported third quarter results that beat revenue expectations but missed on earnings, while issuing disappointing guidance for the current quarter that sent shares down 5%.

items.title: Qualcomm (NASDAQ:QCOM) Beats Q2 Sales Targets But Stock Drops
items.summary: Wireless chipmaker Qualcomm (NASDAQ:QCOM) reported revenue ahead of Wall Street’s expectations in Q2 CY2026, but sales fell by 4% year on year to $9.95 billion. Guidance for next quarter’s revenue was better than expected at $10.1 billion at the midpoint, 1% above analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $2.21 per share was in line with analysts’ consensus estimates.

items.title: Qualcomm forecasts weak quarterly profit, expects Apple revenue drop to accelerate
items.summary: Qualcomm forecast fourth-quarter profit below Wall Street estimates on Wednesday, and said revenue from Apple products would decline faster than expected as supply constraints and rising costs weighed on ‌its business.  In an interview ‌with Reuters, CEO Cristiano Amon said costs had risen not just for memory chips, but across the supply chain.  Qualcomm plans to raise prices ​starting September 1 in an effort to return its margins to historical levels, he said.
